svg.title: VLA model training and multi-view image pipeline
svg.desc: The figure is a block diagram: top-left action candidates flow through text detokenization and tokenization into a central language model; bottom multi-view images flow through a vision encoder and projector; a MovQGAN encoder/decoder connects the language and image streams; right side lists two training stages separated by a vertical rule. Confirmed SAM picture assets are mapped to the repeated vehicle/action icons, four instruction-panel icons, and the language-model graph icon after visible SVG construction.
Action base frame contains four candidate vehicle/action icons labelled Safety, Progress, Comfort, and Optimal, with Selection pointing to Optimal.
Top multi-view output frame contains six next-scene image buttons arranged evenly in a horizontal row.
Main VLA-model region contains tokenizers, language model, MovQGAN encoder/decoder, projector, vision encoder, token sequences, arrows, and the instruction panel.
Central language model base frame is a large grey rounded rectangle spanning the main region.
Instruction panel contains two columns and two rows: Instructions, Ego States, Aspects, and Command, each with a golden icon.
Bottom multi-view input frame contains six input camera view buttons and the label Multi-view Images below.
Vertical separator divides the main architecture from the right-side training stages.
Right-side stage frames list data sources for supervised fine-tuning and instruction-tuning.
